column1: # Files whose trees changed between the delta libraries under error recovery only, reviewed one by one
# (B7b-3 Task 4 ruling; spec 7.2: a change in a file with errors "fails the gate and is reviewed individually").
# tools.perf delta admits a listed file only while its source still has this sha256 AND its old or new tree has an error.

column4: Broken source (the procedure body ending at line 2201 has no end; before the local procedure on line 2202), errors on main and on the branch; every change is recovery: B7b-3 Task 4 makes recovered bare names call_statement (+144/-56 call_statement nodes) and ERROR/; nodes a call_statement used to swallow now sit beside it. Reviewed 2026-10-08. B7b-2 Task 4 (vs the Phase 0 baseline, same broken region): the var declarations that recovery reads as code (lines 2304, 2321, 2350: `array[N] of Decimal`, `array[4] of Record "..."`) recover with `of` as a bare call_statement and `Record` as a separate ERROR, instead of one ERROR span ending at the next `;`; cause: subscript/member objects, binary operands and assignment lefts are `_continuation_operand` (ternary and assignment-expression derivations removed), which changes which reductions error recovery can complete. No tree outside the ERROR region changes. Reviewed 2026-10-20.

Deferred item 10 (split add* headers whose bodies stay open over #endif): errors on main and on the branch. State review C1 (`#endif` a grammar regex, depth-- on the zero-width _endif_mark) makes `#endif` lexable during error recovery, so the preproc_conditional_layout over source rows 11-78 recovers differently (tree lines 26-215 vs 26-212); the ERROR nodes keep their rows (20, 26, 71-77) and nothing outside rows 11-78 changes. Reviewed 2026-11-11. State review C3 (`end` a grammar token): one more node changes, the `end` at source row 75 (tree line 211, inside the recovery region) is an `(end_keyword)` where it was an `(identifier)`; has_error True under C1 and C3. Reviewed 2026-11-11.
